analysis_options.api: Direct RulePtrArith::applyOp invocation; no ActionGroup or other Rule runs
analysis_options.funcdata: Locked BfdArchitecture over the pinned Git-blob curl input supplies the Ghidra Funcdata, address spaces, register/const spaces and the Architecture TypeFactory used to build the case datatypes (uint8/int8 base types, the PtrarithStruct two-field struct, and wordsize-1 pointers). Rugra creates an equivalent isolated Funcdata per case with hand-constructed mirror datatypes of identical size/alignment/metatype.
analysis_options.ir: All initial ops are alive members of the synthetic block wired only through Funcdata op editing APIs. The base pointer is an SSA register input with updateType-assigned (unlocked) pointer datatype; the INT_ADD constant and the LOAD space sentinel (fixed value 1, never consulted by RulePtrArith) are constant varnodes with one descendant. Outputs are unique-space written Varnodes.
analysis_options.normalization: Only allocation-only unique-space offsets are replaced by deterministic fixture identities. Block order, alive/dead order, operand slots, parent/order fields, Varnode storage/value/SSA class, definitions, descendant order, per-Varnode sized-unknown default type rendering, return values, and all target-relevant structural mutations are preserved.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; RulePtrArith and fixture construction are deterministic

assets.source_policy: Materialize the four SLEIGH/spec files and curl binary from verified Git blob IDs at the pinned Rugra provenance commit; never consume their working-tree copies

binary.source_policy: Materialize the pinned provenance commit's examples/curl Git blob by verified object ID; never read the working-tree binary

observation_schema.format: Ten fixed-order UTF-8 records (before/after for five cases) with a final newline
observation_schema.op_state: Target-relevant structural state: exact block/alive/dead order plus opcode, dead flag, parent block index, sequence order, ordered input identities, and output identity
observation_schema.varnode_state: Every fixture-tracked and transformation-created reachable Varnode in deterministic discovery order: space, size, semantic offset, constant/input/written/free classification, defining op, sized data-type metatype rendering, and ordered descendant op.slot list; whole-bank membership, create_index, and unrelated symbol/high annotations are outside this narrow observation schema
observation_schema.mutation_scope: Detached original operands remain in the tracked Varnode list, so target-operand xref removal is observable; generated constants/op/output are discovered and included. The new PTRADD/PTRSUB reuses the original INT_ADD output Varnode, which the shared identity preserves.

OPBANK-0001.detail: Rugra PcodeOpBank cannot represent Ghidra's initially-null input slots. Funcdata::op_set_input replaces temporary sentinel Varnodes before RulePtrArith runs, but those detached bank-only sentinels have no Ghidra counterpart and are outside this target-relevant observation schema.

ARCH-0001.detail: Ghidra runs the synthetic IR in a BfdArchitecture-backed Funcdata, while Rugra's synthetic Funcdata has no equivalent fully loaded Architecture/services graph. RulePtrArith's applyOp path reads only the input Varnode data-types on the five projected cases, so the gap is not observable here, but whole-state identity cannot be claimed.
